hints.title: Count the ratio steps correctly
hints.body: For first term a and ratio r, the fourth term is ar3. Here a=23, so 23r3=9/4.
hints.recap: Term four is three ratio steps after term one.
hints.pitfall: Using r to the fourth power introduces an indexing error.
hints.pause: Isolate r cubed and simplify the surd.

recall.reminder: Use ar raised to n−1 for term n of a GP.

hints.title: Recognise a cube of a surd
hints.body: After isolating the cube of the ratio, simplify the expression exactly. Use index laws to recognise a cube involving a surd. A real number has one real cube root.
hints.recap: Write the expression as a recognisable power before taking its root.
hints.pitfall: There is no plus-or-minus choice for a real cube root.
hints.pause: Find the exact ratio and check whether its magnitude is below one.

recall.reminder: Use index laws and exact radicals together.

hints.title: Check convergence, then rationalise
hints.body: Use the sum-to-infinity formula only after checking the magnitude of the ratio. If the resulting denominator contains a surd, multiply numerator and denominator by its conjugate.
hints.pitfall: Multiply by the conjugate on both numerator and denominator.
hints.pause: Verify convergence, substitute your ratio into the sum formula and simplify the exact result.

recall.reminder: Use the sum-to-infinity formula only after checking the ratio.

knowledgePattern: Infer a surd geometric ratio from the fourth term
